title: Microsoft Purview: protect data sent to unmanaged cloud apps through the Island Enterprise Browser
summary: The briefing's default, licensing, rollout dates and network controls remain supported by Microsoft's current documentation and notice. Two navigation paths omit intermediate configuration steps, and the checklist recommends an audit/block setting that has no corresponding control row; these are minor corrections.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Data Loss Prevention > Security Store > Get solution is the general route to begin the integration.
claims.quote: open the Data Loss Prevention solution and choose Security Store in the left navigation bar. ... Select Get solution for the SASE or non-Microsoft secure browser solution provider you want to integrate with.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or command for enabling the Island integration.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Purview Island integration Security Store enable disable API PowerShell. Read collection-policies-create-deploy-policy and dlp-network-data-security-learn; neither provides an Island enablement API, and search returned no relevant reference.

claims.claim: Non-Microsoft secure browser integration setup is completed using the provider's documentation.
claims.quote: For non-Microsoft SASE or secure browser solutions, refer to that provider's documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet have an Island-specific integration page at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/purview "Island" "network"; Microsoft Purview Island integration Security Store enable disable API PowerShell. Read network overview and both cited policy scenarios; search found no Island-specific Learn page.

claims.claim: The printed new-DLP-policy route reaches Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers.
claims.quote: Select + Add cloud apps. ... Select the Adaptive app scopes tab ... Select Edit scope ... On the Choose where to enforce the policy page, ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is On
claims.fix: Include the omitted app/group scope selection: Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Inline web traffic > Custom > Custom policy > + Add cloud apps > Adaptive app scopes > All unmanaged AI apps > Edit scope > Include only specific > + Add inclusions > Specific users and groups > group > Choose where to enforce the policy > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-ai-network-data-security.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <String> -EnforcementPlanes @("Network") creates a DLP policy with the Network enforcement plane.
claims.quote: The EnforcementPlanes parameter defines the layer where policy actions are run. ... -EnforcementPlanes @("<Value>"). ... Valid values are: ... Network

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy is available in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The policy-creation command does not itself create the rules or set Audit only/Block.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies ... DLP policies contain DLP rules that identify, monitor, and protect sensitive information.

claims.claim: Some features in the cited network DLP scenario are in preview.
claims.quote: Some features used in this scenario are in preview.

claims.claim: The printed collection-policy route reaches Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers.
claims.quote: Select Edit scope on the Unmanaged cloud apps row. ... Leave the default option of Don't capture content and select Next. ... Ensure Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers is enabled
claims.fix: Expand the abbreviated scenario route to: Data loss prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies > + Create policy > + Add condition > Content contains > Classifiers > Edit > Scope for classifiers > Exclude classifiers > + Exclude classifiers > Choose Classifiers > classifiers > + Add activities > activities > + Add data source > Unmanaged cloud apps > cloud apps > Edit scope > Include only specific > Included > + Add inclusions > group > Don't capture content > Network and non-Microsoft secure browsers. Lower-case placeholders denote the selections to make. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/collection-policies-create-deploy-policy.

claims.claim: The cost is variable because pay-as-you-go meters each network request to a website or API, excluding responses.
claims.quote: Network data security uses the request as unit of measure ... A request is each network call made from a device or browser to a website or API. This definition doesn't include the responses to the requests.

claims.claim: Network data security billing counts only requests outbound from the device.
claims.quote: Network data security only counts requests that are outbound from the device.
